lesson_title: From Table to Graph: The Answer Machine
hook_text: This boring table hides the exact price where the market balances. Watch it appear.
clip_script: Now the exam question: find the excess supply at R8. This is where the graph becomes a measuring instrument. Go to R8 on the price axis. Travel horizontally across the graph. You strike the demand curve first — drop down: quantity demanded is 40. Continue across to the supply curve — drop down: quantity supplied is 80. At R8, sellers offer 80 units but buyers take only 40. The market does not balance: quantity supplied exceeds quantity demanded by 80 minus 40 — 40 units. That gap is the excess supply. On the graph it is the horizontal distance between the two curves at the height of R8.
visual_style: Clean animated graph build: points popping onto axes from table rows, curves sweeping through them, then a glowing horizontal ruler at R8 measuring the gap.
pacing: Methodical step-by-step with a quick payoff when the 40-unit gap lights up.
